name: get_stock_info
description: Retrieves comprehensive stock information including current price, daily change, volume, market cap, day high/low, 52-week high/low, and P/E ratio for a given stock ticker symbol. Use this tool when users ask about stock prices, market data, or company valuations.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., 'AAPL' for Apple, 'GOOGL' for Google, 'MSFT' for Microsoft). Must be a valid stock symbol traded on major exchanges.
